name: kbac-person-deploy-prod
display_name: Person: DEPLOY to prod with deployer role
description: Allow a Person to DEPLOY to the prod Environment when they hold the 'deployer' role via a HAS_ROLE edge.

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Person)-[:HAS_ROLE]->(role:Role), (resource:Environment) MATCH (role)-[:HAS]->(role_name:Property {type:'name'}) MATCH (resource)-[:HAS]->(env_name:Property {type:'name'}) WHERE role_name.value = 'deployer' AND env_name.value = 'prod'
